plan.title: Material PR to RFQ PO award

steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule; the separate evaluation duration is listed as not fully expressible.

args.goal: add one Required T&C clause to the event and stop on the create screen showing the clause saved

steps.note: Add the required terms-and-conditions clause, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Invite exactly two QA vendors so both vendor bids can be submitted.
Publish the configured RFQ event.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Submit Vendor A's quote of 100 through the vendor portal.
Verify that the first vendor's quote was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's lower quote of 90 through the second vendor session.
Verify that the second vendor's quote was accepted.
Verify that the buyer sees both direct vendor responses.
Wait for the bidding window to end before ranking and awarding.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after bidding closes.
Verify that the lower RFQ amount ranks first.
Check that the first-ranked vendor column is Rank 1; the catalog does not expose the conceptual Vendor B name.
Enter the awarding flow for the closed event.
Allocate the full award to the lowest-priced vendor.
Verify that the entire line item is allocated to one vendor.
Create and submit the award proposal to the lowest vendor.
Verify that the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.remark: Approved for the lowest evaluated vendor.

steps.note: Approve the submitted award with the required approver remark.
Complete approval and create the purchase order, while reading the resulting PO back.
Verify that one PO contains the awarded PR line with quantity 10.
Return to the events list to verify the event reached history.
Open the History tab for completed events.
Verify that this plan's awarded event appears in event history.
